about: Leads for the bosses of EldenNet's roster (O43, O59) and their bar names: the characters DataPiler found in boss slots (entity ids ending 800 to 899) of the legacy dungeons (en-0007) and the smaller dungeons (en-0010), and the character names no NpcParam row uses, grouped by the shape of their numbers. Numbers only. `barCandidates` are the unused names whose number is 90, then the slot's model, then three digits: a pattern (WHY§47), not a link the data states; the link is in the event scripts, which Smithbox cannot read (WHY§32). Every lead is unverified until EldenNet checks it in game (O48). `layer` is the earliest layer of the game's text that holds the name: 0 the base game, 1 DLC 1, 2 DLC 2. `rowName` is the real name number the slot's row carries, from roster-rows.json.
rule: Maps are those Smithbox's project lists for m10 to m28 (en-0007) and m30 to m45 (en-0010); m10_01_00_99 never listed an entry and is left out (WHY§45). Maps with no placed character are not listed in placed_per_map. `sixDigitBlock` gives, for each unused six-digit name, the real names of roster-rows.json that share its first four digits.
